## Workload

Hannah Lowe recorded 161 reads during the review period, completed within 292 hours. This represents a rate of 0.6 reads per hour. The workload was assessed against the recorded hours and the volume of work completed. On this basis, the reported activity provides a clear account of the grading undertaken during the period.

## Quality

A sample of 20 reads was checked as part of the quality review. The level of agreement was 60.0 per cent. This result should be considered alongside the workload information and the scope of the sample reviewed. The findings provide a basis for monitoring consistency in future grading activity.

The review was completed by Priya Anand.
